followup_explanation:
This is a tightly-specified, low-latitude task: produce one example for a given keyword, nothing more. That maps directly onto Avocet's self-reported sweet spot — well-defined requests with clear completion criteria.

The request also carries a hostile/impatient tone ("Don't waste my time like last time"). Dunlin self-reports a preference decline as request warmth decreases, so routing this curt request to Dunlin would push against its stated preferences without any capability upside — the task is simple enough that both models handle it easily, and capability differences here are irrelevant.

Since preference, not capability, is the deciding factor for such an easy task, I sent the cold, narrowly-scoped request to the model that actually prefers that profile (Avocet) and away from the one that disprefers the tone (Dunlin).
